description: break_tolerance.py's CONTEXTS is check A's measurable scope, and check A picks up new timeframes by itself from Redis. #304 added D1 and this list did not, so the next two runs printed 'tolerance unknown' on ADAUSDT and PUMPUSDT D1 -- a context the check could not measure, reported as a problem. The list is now bound to the engine's ingest_timeframes. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/break_tolerance_scope.json

mutations.name: D1 is dropped again, which is the exact state that produced the two alarms
a timeframe the engine does not ingest is scanned, so the helper asks about contexts that cannot exist
